english_text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
tigrinya_text: እቶም ንእግዚኣብሄር ዚጽበዩ ግና ሓይሎም ይሕደስ። ከም ንስሪ በኽናፍ ይድይቡ፡ ይጐዩ እሞ ኣይሕለሉን፡ ይኸዱ እሞ ኣይደኽሙን።

english_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
tigrinya_text: ኣነ ዝሐስበልኩም ዘሎኹ ሓሳብ እፈልጦ እየ፡ መፈጸምታን ተስፋን ክህበኩምሲ፡ ሓሳብ ደሓን እምበር፡ ናይ ክፉእ ኣይኰነን፡ ይብል እግዚኣብሄር።

english_text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
